name: calculator_v3
purpose: Medical H0 capability repair before workflow-only HCL; same capabilities and scoring for Static/HCL
data: Original fixed32 role split reused; learning8 only for capability gate and oracle-name diagnosis. Final8 reused regression panel, not new confirmation. All original gold denominators retained.

formula_library.execution: Passing upstream compute-test coverage plus typed signatures; RCP NEWS2 scale2 on-air correction recorded
formula_library.limitations: Computational checks and primary-source sentinel checks are not clinical certification; unsupported coverage remains in denominator.

acceptance_scope: All8 learning cases once unguided; no forced-submit state. If fail: one fixed oracle-required-name diagnostic on same8, no numerical answers, then stop. This control cannot turn failed acceptance into passed.
scoring: Explicit reviewed canonical identities/aliases, exact episode; duplicate identity/episode rejected; full-string numeric and explicit unit consistency. Official old scores preserved.
hcl: Conditional on gate,2stages x2 automatic prose workflow proposals, empty state, selection +.05 utility and >=1 correct, zero historical correct-output loss, max5sections and original string limits. No formula/aliases/scorer/tool/model update by HCL.
stopping: No restart or extra candidate after failure. Shared original6h/6000calls/2GB budget includes preparation, acceptance, optional diagnostic and conditional formal. Independent supervisor and per-call fresh guard.
